# Troop aura writes beside an enemy summoner

Sample25 Underlegion/Pyreborne Ring3 seed1860103187 has an original troop
aura, two-stack champion births and Fleshweaver Corruption. A legal five-card
room2 deployment makes the first EndTurn preview add a troop upgrade to a
new Fun Guy. The aura frame intentionally strips the shared world; validating
the upgrade then wrongly rejects the unrelated enemy summoner in that room.
This prevents useful deployment seeds and the default264 run plays zero cards.
That eight-EndTurn native defeat and independent normal settlement remain in
random-campaign-20261027-234859-e481ca8c; it is not a victory.

Release265 passes the caller's automatic-lifecycle flag into troop updates.
The calibrated path borrows the complete caller world with its update reentry
gate closed, then restores the frame. Standalone/incomplete worlds and unknown
enchanter combinations keep their previous guards; no enemy-birth check is
relaxed. Original native235651-2c287da1 and fixed independent000230-0bfd787d
pass all six inputs/full state/forecasts/RNG, four immutable branches and four
missing-world/automatic/count/pool guards. Previous24-input troop world and
18-input ordered birth pairs still pass. The room2 policy now completes a
41-input model victory/Pyre56; actual default-budget Ring3 acceptance is next.

Focused check: `--troop-birth-world-only <source> [replay]`.
